title: Management workload and assurance dashboard
scope: Display workload, elapsed time, unresolved evidence, false positives and legal-route coverage from measured data

acceptance.text: Display workload, elapsed time, unresolved evidence, false positives and legal-route coverage from measured data
Verify denominators, missing-data states and supervisor-only visibility
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR
Follow docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; supply relevant viewport/state screenshots and keyboard/accessibility evidence for human visual review

verification: Verify denominators, missing-data states and supervisor-only visibility

evidence.text: Supervisor-only dashboard /auditor/management (ManagementView.vue) shows workload (open cases by status and officer, unassigned), elapsed time (open-case age and time to close: median, nearest-rank p90, longest), unresolved evidence (outstanding, overdue, cases affected), closures with no further action (false positives) and after correction, legal-route coverage, and audit ledger assurance. Figures come from getManagementSummary (GET /api/v1/management/summary, ADR-020), which the fixture API measures from auditor_queue.json and the synthetic management.json, sealing the ledger events with the TAX-059 vati_tax.audit.ledger functions. Commit 859679f.

Denominators: every ratio is {numerator, denominator}; closure ratios share one denominator that excludes closures without a recorded outcome; breakdowns add up to totals; a zero denominator reads 'No data', never 0% (tests/contracts/test_management_summary.py, 17 tests; vitest parser rejects 13 kinds of inconsistent or non-synthetic data). Missing data: closures or open cases without timestamps are excluded, counted and listed in missing_data; an unavailable ledger is a listed gap, not zeros; a tampered chain shows as failed. Supervisor-only: officer without the role and unknown principal get 403 forbidden with no data, another tenant 403, and the UI shows 'Supervisors only' with no figures; signals about the viewer are withheld and no logins reach the response. Playwright management.spec.ts: 12 tests pass in Edge.

docs/evidence/TAX-060: screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px plus loading, denied, empty and ledger-broken states, captured in Edge (README lists them). Tables only, with no decorative charts; shared PageLayout, StatePanel and CaseStatusBadge; status shown as text plus colour. axe (WCAG 2 A/AA) finds no serious or critical violations and there is no page-wide horizontal scroll at all three widths, in both management.spec.ts and the TAX-023 matrix (management route added; 30 of 30 auditor harness tests pass). The window control and focusable table regions are reachable by keyboard, with visible focus. Visual approval is left to the reviewer.

Tests and results recorded under criteria 1, 2 and 4 (contract 22 examples; tests/contracts incl. 17 new; dev.py check steps pass except the 2 existing Windows-only tests/tooling file-permission tests; ruff, mypy and npm run check pass; auditor Playwright 34 pass; TAX-023 auditor harness 30 of 30). Status set to IN_REVIEW and review PR #158 opened; the agent will not merge.
